=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .claude/commands/audit-plans.md:39 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The tracking-issue listing `gh api "repos/<owner>/<repo>/issues?labels=ai:orchestrator-tracking&state=open"` has no `--paginate` or `per_page`, so only the first 30 items are read, yet the command treats the result as the complete set (identical copy at workflow-templates/.claude/commands/audit-plans.md).
  WHY: With more than 30 open tracking issues, a plan that is in flight can look idle, so step 4a can edit it and step 6 can miss it in the conflict gate. The fail-closed branch never triggers because the call succeeds. Severity is MAJOR in the source reports, mapped to high.
- .claude/commands/audit-plans.md:126,139 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The recommendation blocks carry a staleness caveat only when step 4a refreshed the plan ("Refreshed in <maintenance PR url>"). A plan marked STALE but not refreshed (listing unreadable, fail-closed) gets no caveat (identical copy in workflow-templates/.claude/commands/audit-plans.md).
  WHY: In degraded mode step 6 can still pick the plan as UNSCREENED, so the operator hands off stale default-branch text believing it matches the repo, which defeats step 4a. Severity is MAJOR in the source reports, mapped to high.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
